question: ______ broke the world record for 300 m at the Ostrava Golden Spike in June 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaunae Miller-Uibo.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shaunae Miller-Uibo**

 
 
• Shaunae Miller-Uibo is a **Bahamian track and field sprinter.**
 
• She competes in the 200 and 400 meters.
 
• She is a** two-time Olympic champion** after winning the women's 400 meters at the 2016 Rio Olympics and again at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• She is the 2022 World Champion over 400m having won gold in Eugene.
 
• She sets a new World 300m record at the 58th Ostrava Golden Spike.
 
• She broke the world record finishing with a huge lead in 34.41, erasing the prior mark of 35.30 by Mexico's Ana Guevara in 2003.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carl Lewis**

 
 
• **​**Frederick Carlton Lewis is an **American former track and field athlete.**
 
• He won nine Olympic gold medals, one Olympic silver medal, and 10 World Championships medals, including eight gold.
 
• He is one of only six Olympic athletes who won a gold medal in the same individual event in four consecutive Olympic Games.
 
 
 
• **Eliud Kipchoge**
 
 
• **​**Eliud Kipchoge is a Kenyan professional **long-distance runner.**
 
• He is the 2016 and 2020 Olympic marathon champion.
 
• He holds the world record in the marathon with a time of 2:01:39 set at the 2018 Berlin Marathon.
 
• He is widely regarded as the greatest ever marathon runner and one of the greatest sportsmen in history.
 
 
 
• **Usain Bolt**
 
 
• **​**Usain St. Leo Bolt is a retired** Jamaican sprinter.**
 
• He is widely considered to be the greatest sprinter of all time.
 
• He is the **world record holder** in the 100 metres, 200 metres, and 4 × 100 metres relay.
